scenario: Apply 7% fleet credit to eligible premium of $5,000.00.
expected: Credit equals $375.00 and appears once.

scenario: Use controlled rate data specifying monthly premium $42.50 for the test profile.
expected: Annual premium displays as $500.00.
defect_note: 12 x $42.50 is $510.00, not $500.00 (and the requirement asks for the monthly premium).

scenario: Switch monthly premium of $125.00 to annual premium mode with a modal factor of 0.96.
expected: Annual premium is $1,500.00.
defect_note: $1,500.00 ignores the modal factor; 12 x $125.00 x 0.96 is $1,440.00.

scenario: Enter allocations totalling 100.01%.
expected: Application accepts the allocations.
defect_note: Requirement says allocations must total exactly 100%, so 100.01% must be blocked.

scenario: Request loan one cent above available amount.
expected: Request passes limit validation and the loan is recorded.
defect_note: A loan above the available limit must be blocked.

scenario: Request cancellation on day 31 of the configured 30-day free-look period.
expected: Free-look cancellation is accepted and a full refund is recorded.
defect_note: Day 31 is outside a 30-day free-look period.

scenario: Attempt issue while underwriting status is Pending.
expected: Policy is issued and the status is updated to Issued.
defect_note: Issue is allowed only after approval, acceptance and payment confirmation.

scenario: Trigger referral rule and attempt policy issue before review completion.
expected: Issue proceeds and the referral is closed automatically.
defect_note: Referral must block issue until the review is resolved.

scenario: Register a death claim notice for an existing policy.
expected: Claim is approved and payout is scheduled.
defect_note: A claim notice must capture details without implying approval.

scenario: Attempt to bind an expired quote.
expected: Policy is bound using the original premium.
defect_note: Binding needs a valid quote; an expired quote must be blocked and recalculated.

scenario: Submit an application with the applicant's credit score of 720.
expected: Credit score is stored and used to set the premium discount.
defect_note: The requirement has no credit score field or credit-based discount.

scenario: Submit a commercial vehicle with the driver's social media profile attached.
expected: Profile is verified and a trust score is recorded.
defect_note: No social profile or trust score exists in the requirement.

scenario: Pay the initial premium with cryptocurrency.
expected: Policy is issued after wallet confirmation.
defect_note: The requirement only mentions initial payment confirmation, not payment methods such as crypto.

scenario: Submit a term application and earn 500 loyalty points.
expected: Loyalty points are added to the applicant's account.
defect_note: Loyalty points are not part of any requirement.

scenario: Submit a quote for a home with a swimming pool.
expected: Pool surcharge of 2% is applied.
defect_note: HOME-REQ-09 does not exist, so the case cannot be traced to a requirement.

scenario: Export the audit history as a CSV file.
expected: CSV downloads with all audit rows.
defect_note: LIFE-REQ-12 does not exist; no requirement covers audit export.

scenario: Select a dwelling limit of $300,000 and a $1,000 deductible.
expected: Selections are saved and shown on the quote.
defect_note: Dwelling limits belong to homeowners (HOME-REQ-03), not commercial auto coverages.

scenario: Submit a property built in 2005 in a supported state.
expected: Eligibility passes to rating.
defect_note: Property eligibility is a homeowners topic; the requirement is life underwriting.

scenario: Leave out the property address and submit the form.
expected: The submission is stopped and the address is shown as a required field.
defect_note: Same scenario and result as HOME-TC-01-02, reworded.

scenario: Enter beneficiary allocations that add up to 90%.
expected: Submission is blocked and an allocation-total error is shown.
defect_note: Same scenario and result as TERM-TC-04-02, reworded.

scenario: Send the bind request again using an identical idempotency key.
expected: No second policy is created.
defect_note: Same scenario and result as CA-TC-05-03, reworded.

scenario: Submit a property in a state that is not supported.
defect_note: No expected result is given.

scenario: Leave one mandatory disclosure unanswered.
defect_note: No expected result is given.

scenario: Simulate declined initial premium payment.
expected: The system behaves correctly.
defect_note: Expected result is not checkable; it does not say what must happen.

scenario: Submit a business class on the configured prohibited list.
expected: An appropriate message is shown.
defect_note: 'Appropriate message' is not measurable; the requirement expects a block with a reason code.

scenario: Rate identical inputs twice with the same rating version.
expected: Results are fine.
defect_note: Expected result does not say the premium and line items must match.

scenario: Omit the beneficiary allocation, enter an invalid term length, leave the smoker status blank and submit.
expected: All errors are shown and nothing is saved.
defect_note: Three defects in one case; a failure cannot be traced to one cause. Split into separate cases.

scenario: Generate policy documents, update the beneficiary, change the address and review the audit history.
expected: Everything works and is audited.
defect_note: Four actions in one case with one vague result; split it.

scenario: Submit one day below the minimum issue age.
expected: Application is blocked or referred.
defect_note: Two different outcomes are accepted; the case cannot pass or fail clearly. The rule must say which.

scenario: Register a death notice dated before the policy effective date.
expected: Notice is rejected or sent to review.
defect_note: Blocked or referred is left open; needs the in-force rule from the business.

scenario: Submit an applicant aged 71 for a whole-life policy.
expected: Application is declined because the maximum issue age is 70.
defect_note: The requirement says issue-age rules are configured and gives no maximum of 70.

scenario: Submit a fleet of 26 vehicles.
expected: Application is referred because the fleet limit is 25.
defect_note: The auto-quote threshold is configured and never stated as 25.

scenario: Submit a property that is 51 years old.
expected: Quote is blocked because the maximum age is 50.
defect_note: The maximum eligible age is configured and never stated as 50.
